title: RestrictedUnlockedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'restricted.unlocked'. STATE.md P2.8: emitted when a user successfully completes POST /restricted/unlock (gate 5, docs/PLAN.md §6.4). USER-SCOPED delivery — see restricted.locked.schema.json's description; the same rules apply here (packages/db/src/query/events.ts's USER_ONLY_TYPES, packages/db/src/query/identity.ts writes this in the same transaction as the user_settings.restricted_unlocked_until_ms update).
